units.source_text: 一个温暖的下午，天气略阴沉，拉卟得意的陪我一起去参观这座大寺院了。

en.t: On a warm afternoon, with the sky a little overcast, Lap proudly took me along to visit this great temple.

units.source_text: 果不其然，这是一座至少比尼古莱教堂大十倍的巍峨雄壮的建筑物，并且融合了几乎所有的建筑样式。

en.t: Sure enough, it was a majestic building at least ten times larger than the Nikolai Cathedral, and it combined nearly every architectural style.

units.source_text: 我站在这座大寺院前面，望着那高耸的塔和圆屋顶时，竟然感到有些恐惧。

en.t: Standing before the great temple and looking up at its towering spires and round domes, I unexpectedly felt a little afraid.

units.source_text: 说真的，它们真的非常像是无数只伸向天空的触角。

en.t: To tell the truth, they really looked very much like countless feelers reaching toward the sky.

units.source_text: 我们在大门口站立（和这大门相比，我们愈加渺小了！），仰望了片刻这座世上少有的大寺院——

en.t: We stood at the great gate, where we seemed even smaller beside it, and for a while looked up at this rare great temple of the world—

units.source_text: 与其说是建筑，不如说它是庞然大物。

en.t: It was less a building than a colossal creature.
